# Rule 6 — Responsible Antagonist Play The purpose of an antagonist is to make the round interesting, exciting, and dangerous, but within reasonable limits. Antagonists may not ambush newly spawned players, release plasma or the singularity, or otherwise perform actions that can be classified as griefing. Remember that "minor" antagonists are covert and discreet. Other, "major" antagonists exist for open confrontations and loud operations.
